title: Page 7
lines: 「那何不留下？裴府不差你一双碗筷。」裴璎珞主动开口留人，不忍见她此刻彷徨无依的神情。
「多谢裴姑娘！」乔姥姥激动地望着她，也不多说客套的话，一来是真的无处可去，二来是她想弥补并侍候裴璎珞。
秋月闻言，无奈地仰首翻了个白眼，彻底对这个善良不记仇的二小姐没辙。
午后，璎珞楼内一如以往的静寂。裴府上下皆知裴璎珞有午睡的习惯，加上她这次回来又再次发病，众人更是紧张小心地侍候。因此众人在经过璎珞楼月洞门前，莫不特别放轻脚步，且不敢出声，就怕惊扰到正在午睡的娇人儿。
此时，两抹人影在踏入月洞门前互瞪了彼此一眼后，这才同时放轻步伐踏了进去。
「姥姥，我家二小姐自有我小心照料，不劳你费心。」秋月压低声音，双手端着一盅鸡汤，不满地瞪着身旁这个老爱抢她工作的人。
「我这盅补汤，可是我加入十几种珍贵药材，熬煮了三个时辰，绝对胜过你手中的鸡汤。」
乔姥姥双手端着的正是她辛苦了一个早上的补汤，心知这丫头不喜欢她，记恨她害她家二小姐一再发病，所以她留下来的第一件事，就是要尽快帮裴姑娘调养好身子，否则要是少主来了，见着裴璎珞这病弱的模样，铁定心疼极了。
「姥姥，你只是留在我们裴府的客人，年纪又大，实在不需要为我家二小姐费心。」秋月小声地说，暗示她哪边凉快哪边去。
乔姥姥轻悄地推开房门后，同样压低声音，瞪着身旁不善的小丫头。
「我侍候的是裴姑娘又不是你这丫头，你啰嗦个什么劲。况且裴姑娘都没说什么了，你这丫头再吵就休怪我不客气了。」
乔姥姥将补汤放在小厅的圆桌上后，做出一个手刀姿势，警告这个不知死活的丫头。这小丫头以为灵山岛的人好欺负吗？
「二小姐是不好意思拒绝，免得让你难过。还有，你要是敢动手试试看！」
秋月双手叉腰，抬起下颚，一副她有胆子就放马过来的模样；她就不信她真敢伤害她。
「臭丫头，若不是看在裴姑娘的面子上，你这条小命早就没了。」乔姥姥悻悻然咬牙低道。
「哼！一秋月的回应是双臂环胸，甩头不理她。
「唉！你们两个一定要一见面就吵个没完吗？」窗下卧榻上的娇人儿佣懒地起身，无奈地叹了口气。
「都是你！」
「都是你！」
两人异口同声指责对方后，转向裴璎珞时又是一脸心虚。
「二小姐，不好意思，把你给吵醒了。」
「裴姑娘，抱歉吵醒你了。不过既然你醒了，就过来喝些补汤。这补汤可是我熬煮了一个早上。」乔姥姥掀开盅盖，顿时一阵药香飘散房内。
「二小姐，我准备了人篸杞枸鸡汤，你快来喝吧。」秋月走上前扶起她，再搀着她到圆桌旁落坐，将鸡汤摆放到她面前。
裴璎珞掩嘴打了个哈欠，仍是一脸困倦；看着眼前的两盅汤，她其实很想说可不可以都不要喝啊！抬头望着面前两张期盼的脸，在心底叹了口气。
「好，谢谢你们，我都会喝完的。」她拿起调羹，先是喝了口鸡汤，再喝了口补汤。因为如果不这么喝的话，这两人一定又会在她面前上演她对谁比较偏心，然后委屈地朝她哭诉。
秋月和乔姥姥这才满意地笑开来，一转头看见对方，又将头甩向一旁。
裴璎珞好不容易喝完两碗汤，睡意已尽失，打算出房走走。
叩叩。房门外此时传来敲门声，秋月连忙上前开门，在瞧见外头站的人后，连忙弯身一福，恭敬地低道：
「大少爷。」
裴琥珀目光扫过房内三人，俊逸的脸上含笑，自是没错过桌上的两碗汤，还有二妹无奈的神情。
「璎珞，有人要见你，只是这人就不知你想不想见了？」
「是谁？」裴璎珞好奇地问。
「慕容彻。」裴琥珀话说完后，目光停在乔姥姥身上，注意到她神情欣喜中带着愧疚。
裴璎珞柔美的小脸微变，沉默了会，望着仍站门外的大哥。
「大哥，麻烦你转告他，我不想见他，也没有理由再见他了。」
此话一出，乔姥姥脸色大变，一脸焦急地看着她。「裴姑娘……」
「好，我知道了。」裴琥珀颔首，大步离开。
「裴姑娘，这一切都是我的错，不关少主的事，你能原谅老身，为何不能原谅少主呢？」
乔姥姥急着求情。好不容易等到少主来了，可现在裴姑娘却不想见少主，还有她方才说的那些话又是什么意思？
裴璎珞起身，莲步轻移来到窗下，望着窗外逐渐枯黄的树叶，就犹如她此刻的心情，已回不到从前了。
「因为我无法原谅的是他对我的不信任，就直接判定我的罪。这几个月来，我冷静想过，或许我和他之间的感情发展得太快，以致不够了解彼此。在灵山岛那一个月，我过得很快乐，但好梦由来最易醒。当事情发生时，他不信任我的为人，用最恶毒的话来伤害我。如今想来，他那冷酷无情的模样仍令我害怕，或许我们两个不适合吧。」娇软的嗓音含怨幽幽地说。
「没错！二小姐你能想通就好。慕容彻笑里藏刀、手段残忍，绝不适合二小姐的，还是黎少爷比较适合二小姐。」秋月急忙点头，高兴二小姐终于想通了。
「裴姑娘，少主对你的感情是真的，若非我从中阻拦，少主早已打算向你提亲，他亲手制作的手链就代表少主对你的心意啊！」
乔姥姥气恼地狠瞪了碍事的秋月一眼，再转头面对裴璎珞，急着劝她改变心意。
「姥姥，别再说了，我想静一静，你们都出去吧！秋月，若是慕容公子走了，麻烦请大哥来一趟吧。」
「慕容公子请回吧，璎珞不想见你。」
裴琥珀回到大厅，对着眼前身形与自己相当的慕容彻客气地下逐客令。
两人互相打量着对方。衣着颜色雷同，两人都喜欢月牙白袍；外表同样出色，脸上也都爱挂着一抹笑。只不过裴琥珀的笑就如同他妻子曲玲珑所言，笑得一脸桃花，女人缘极佳；而慕容彻的笑看似无害，笑容底下却处处透着绝情。
「裴兄，曾听璎珞提起，你有意与灵凤轩合作？」
慕容彻即使听见裴璎珞不想见他，心下起了大幅震动，但他明白必须耐住性子；这儿是裴府，眼前的裴琥珀也不是个好应付之人。
裴琥珀望着眼前含笑沉着的男人，若非他方才眼神微变，他几乎要以为他的话对他没有任何影响。这是个善于隐藏自己心思、心机深沉的男人。
「没错，那的确是我一开始希望璎珞去拜访你的理由，但现在已没有这个必要了。」
「这话是什么意思？」慕容彻笑容不变。
「生意再怎么重要，也比不上家人重要。璎珞是我的妹妹，她的感受胜过所有，我不会再让她受到一丁点伤害，更何况她现在的身子已不如从前了。」裴琥珀脸色沉重地望着笑容僵在脸上的慕容彻。
「她的身子怎么样了？是不是厥心痛病症又发作了？」慕容彻急问，俊脸上的担忧显露无遗。
裴琥珀深深地打量他一会。心想，他对璎珞的关心不似作假，看来二妹想摆脱这个男人，只怕难了。
「御医说她郁塞于胸结难解，才会一再发病。每次发病对她的身子都是损伤，若是发病时来不及救治，随时都会丧命。」裴琥珀也不隐瞒的直说了。
content_en:
"Then why not stay? The Pei Mansion will give you a pair of bowls and chopsticks." Pei Yingluo took the initiative to stay, and couldn't bear to see her hesitant and helpless look at this moment.
"Thank you, Miss Pei!" Grandma Qiao looked at her excitedly and didn't say any polite words. Firstly, she really had nowhere to go, and secondly, she wanted to make amends and serve Pei Yingluo.
Hearing this, Qiu Yue looked up helplessly and rolled her eyes, completely helpless towards this kind-hearted second lady who did not hold grudges.
In the afternoon, the Yingluo Building was as quiet as ever. Everyone in the Pei family knew that Pei Yingluo had the habit of taking a nap, and since she was ill again this time when she came back, everyone was even more nervous and careful to serve her. Therefore, when everyone passed by the Moon Cave Gate of Yingluo Tower, they all stepped very softly and did not dare to make a sound, for fear of disturbing the sweet lady who was taking a nap.
At this time, the two figures glared at each other before stepping into the moon cave door, and then stepped in at the same time with a light pace.
"Grandma, I will take good care of my second young lady, so I don't need to worry about you." Qiuyue lowered her voice, holding a cup of chicken soup in both hands, and glared dissatisfied at the person next to her who always liked to steal her job.
"This is my cup of tonic soup, but I added more than a dozen precious medicinal materials and simmered it for three hours. It is definitely better than the chicken soup in your hand."
What Grandma Qiao was holding in her hands was the soup she had worked so hard for all morning. She knew that this girl didn't like her and hated her for causing the second daughter of her family to get sick again and again. Therefore, the first thing she did when she stayed was to help Miss Pei get well as soon as possible. Otherwise, if the young master came and saw Pei Yingluo looking so sick, she would definitely feel heartbroken.
"Grandma, you are just a guest staying in our Pei Mansion. You are too old. You really don't need to worry about my second lady." Qiuyue said in a low voice, hinting to her to go where she could to cool off.
After Grandma Qiao gently opened the door, she also lowered her voice and glared at the unkind little girl next to her.
"I'm serving Miss Pei, not you, so why are you so verbose? Besides, Miss Pei didn't say anything, so don't blame me for being rude if you make a fuss."
After Grandma Qiao placed the tonic soup on the round table in the small hall, she made a knife gesture to warn this ignorant girl. Does this little girl think the people on Lingshan Island are easy to bully?
"Second Miss, I'm embarrassed to refuse, so as not to make you sad. Also, if you dare to do it, try it!"
Qiuyue put her hands on her hips and raised her chin, as if she would come over if she dared; she didn't believe that she really dared to hurt her.
"Stinky girl, if it wasn't for Miss Pei's sake, your life would have been lost a long time ago." Grandma Qiao said through gritted teeth.
"Hmph! Yi Qiuyue's response was to cross her arms across her chest and ignore her.
"Oh! Do you two have to quarrel endlessly as soon as you meet?" The sweet girl on the couch under the window lazily stood up and sighed helplessly.
"It's all you!"
"It's all you!"
After the two accused each other in unison, they looked guilty again when they turned to Pei Yingluo.
"Second Miss, I'm sorry for waking you up."
"Miss Pei, I'm sorry to wake you up. But since you're awake, come over and drink some tonic soup. I've been boiling this tonic soup all morning." Grandma Qiao opened the lid of the cup, and a burst of medicinal fragrance suddenly filled the room.
"Second Miss, I have prepared chicken soup with wolfberry and wolfberry. Come and drink it." Qiuyue stepped forward and helped her up, then helped her sit down at the round table and placed the chicken soup in front of her.
Pei Yingluo covered her mouth and yawned, but she still looked sleepy. Looking at the two cups of soup in front of her, she actually wanted to say whether she could not drink it at all! He looked up at the two expectant faces in front of him and sighed in his heart.
"Okay, thank you, I will finish it." She picked up the spoon and took a sip of the chicken soup first, and then the tonic soup. Because if she didn't drink like this, the two of them would definitely show off in front of her who she was more partial to, and then cry to her in grievance.
Only then did Qiuyue and Grandma Qiao smile with satisfaction. When they turned their heads and saw each other, they threw their heads aside again.
Pei Yingluo finally finished two bowls of soup. She had lost all her sleep and planned to leave the room for a walk.
Knock knock. There was a knock on the door. Qiuyue quickly stepped forward to open the door. After seeing the person standing outside, she quickly bent over and whispered respectfully:
"Young Master."
Pei Hubo glanced at the three people in the room, with a smile on his handsome face, and he did not miss the two bowls of soup on the table, as well as the helpless look on his second sister's face.
"Yingluo, someone wants to see you, but you don't know if you want to see this person?"
"Who is it?" Pei Yingluo asked curiously.
"Murong Che." After Pei Hupe finished speaking, his eyes stopped on Grandma Qiao and noticed her expression of joy and guilt.
Pei Yingluo's soft little face changed slightly, and she was silent for a while, looking at her elder brother who was still standing outside the door.
"Brother, please tell him that I don't want to see him, and I have no reason to see him again."
As soon as these words came out, Grandma Qiao's face changed drastically and she looked at her anxiously. "Miss Pei..."
"Okay, I understand." Pei Hubo nodded and strode away.
"Miss Pei, this is all my fault and it has nothing to do with the young master. If you can forgive me, why can't you forgive the young master?"
Grandma Qiao was anxious to plead for mercy. It took a lot of effort to wait for the young master to come, but now Miss Pei doesn't want to see the young master, and what does she mean by what she just said?
Pei Yingluo stood up, walked lightly to the window, and looked at the withering leaves outside the window, as if her mood at the moment could no longer return to the past.
"Because what I can't forgive is his distrust of me, he directly convicted me. In the past few months, I have thought calmly that maybe the relationship between him and I developed too fast and we did not understand each other well enough. I was very happy during that month on Lingshan Island, But good dreams are the easiest to wake up from. When things happened, he didn't trust me as a person and used the most vicious words to hurt me. Now that I think about it, his cold and ruthless appearance still scares me. Maybe the two of us are not suitable for each other." The soft voice said with a hint of resentment.
"That's right! As long as you can figure it out, Second Miss. Murong Che hides a knife in his smile and is cruel in his methods. He is definitely not suitable for Second Miss. Master Li is more suitable for Second Miss." Qiuyue nodded hurriedly, happy that Second Miss finally figured it out.
"Miss Pei, the young master's feelings for you are true. If I hadn't stopped him, the young master had already planned to propose marriage to you. The bracelet he made by himself represents the young master's feelings for you!"
Grandma Qiao glared at Qiu Yue angrily, then turned to face Pei Yingluo, eager to persuade her to change her mind.
"Grandma, stop talking. I want to be quiet for a while. You all should go out! Qiuyue, if Master Murong is gone, please ask your elder brother to come."
"Yes."
Chapter 10(1)
"Mr. Murong, please come back. Yingluo doesn't want to see you."
Pei Hubo returned to the hall and politely ordered Murong Che to leave in front of him, who was about the same size as himself.
The two looked at each other. Their clothes are of the same color, and they both like crescent white robes; they both look equally good, and both like to have a smile on their faces. It's just that Pei Hubo's smile is just like what his wife Qu Linglong said, with a peach blossom smile on his face, which makes him very popular with women; while Murong Che's smile seems harmless, but there is ruthlessness underneath the smile.
"Brother Pei, I heard Yingluo mention that you are interested in cooperating with Lingfengxuan?"
Even though Murong Che was greatly shocked when he heard that Pei Yingluo didn't want to see him, he knew that he had to be patient; this was the Pei Mansion, and the Pei Hubo in front of him was not an easy person to deal with.
Pei Amber looked at the smiling and calm man in front of him. If his eyes hadn't changed slightly just now, he would have almost thought that his words had no impact on him. This is a man who is good at hiding his thoughts and has a deep scheming mind.
"Yes, that was indeed the reason why I wanted Yingluo to visit you in the first place, but it is no longer necessary."
"What do you mean by this?" Murong Che's smile did not change.
"No matter how important business is, it is not as important as family. Yingluo is my sister, and her feelings are more important than anything else. I will not let her get hurt in the slightest, not to mention that her body is not as good as before." Pei Hubo looked at Murong Che, who had a smile on his face, with a heavy face.
"How is her health? Has the heartache relapsed again?" Murong Che asked urgently, the worry on his handsome face clearly revealed.
Pei Hubo looked at him deeply for a while. I thought to myself that his concern for Yingluo was not fake. It seemed that it would be difficult for the second sister to get rid of this man.
"The imperial doctor said that she was suffering from chest knots that were difficult to resolve, which was why she got sick again and again. Every time she got sick, her body was damaged. If she didn't get treatment in time when she got sick, she would die at any time." Pei Hubo said it bluntly without hiding anything.
